prerequisites.text: Chemistry/Biochemistry: Chemistry (equivalent to 25% of a year study load) followed by Biochemistry (equivalent to a 25%-year load), including fundamentals of molecular biology, macronutrient structure, function and metabolism, cellular metabolism and regulation.

prerequisites.text: Human Biology and Human Physiology: Human Physiology content with Human Biology (equivalent to a 25%-year study load) followed by Human Physiology (25% of a year study load), including the eight body systems.

prerequisites.text: Human Nutrition and Food Science (equivalent to 25% of a year study load), including general principles of nutrition, essential nutrients, energy balance and nutrient analysis of foods.
prerequisites.quote: 1.3 Human Nutrition and Food Science (equivalent to 25% of a year study load) - This must include general principles of nutrition, essential nutrients (food sources, storage and function of macronutrients and micronutrients), principles of energy balance and nutrient analysis of foods.
